review_notes: I read the whole file and searched Mathlib for existing notions of monoid division ("quotient of a submonoid", MonoidDivides, GroupDivides and similar). I found no matching declaration. The local divisor, with its twisted product and identity c, also has no Mathlib counterpart. The Mul/One/Monoid instances are built directly on a subtype of M with a non-standard product, so they are not a competing version of an existing structure. `LocalDivisor.val` is a thin wrapper around Subtype.val. It is needed because LocalDivisor is a plain def, and I saw no practical cost from it. I did not report it. The `MonoidDivides` definition is the standard ∃ submonoid and surjective hom formulation. Mathlib has no named relation to replace it, and the file's own uses in PrimeDecomposition and FactorTower rely on it.
